test.query: SELECT product(if(number % 2 = 0, 0.999999, 1.000001)) FROM numbers(10000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT arrayProduct(groupArray(if(number % 2 = 0, 0.999999, 1.000001))) FROM numbers(10000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT productIf(if(number % 2 = 0, 0.999999, 1.000001), number % 3 = 0) FROM numbers(10000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT productIf(if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, 1.0), number % 2 = 0) FROM numbers(10000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT product(if(number % 2 = 0, 0.999999, 1.000001)) FROM numbers(10000000) GROUP BY number % 1000000 FORMAT Null
